metadata.scope: World-known roadster / open-top two-seat sports car models, 2024-2026 model years, for a Portugal-based buyer
metadata.phase1_methodology: Iterative web-search deep research merging models until additional search rounds stopped surfacing new mainstream/premium/GT/mid-exotic models. NOTE: the ultra-exotic bespoke/coachbuilt hypercar tier (Bugatti, Pagani, Bentley Mulliner, Rolls-Royce Coachbuild, Aspark, Ferrari special series, Hennessey) has a genuinely open-ended long tail -- new sold-out limited editions surface from this tier on a near-weekly cadence, so absolute completeness cannot be claimed there. Coverage is exhaustive for mainstream/premium/GT-convertible/mid-tier-exotic categories as of the generation date.
metadata.phase2_methodology: Real for-sale listings searched Portugal-first (Standvirtual, OLX.pt, AutoScout24.pt, PT authorized dealers), then wider Europe. Phase 2 (selling_items population) was SKIPPED for any model whose average_budget_eur exceeds 100,000 EUR, per instruction -- those entries have phase2_status = 'skipped_price_threshold'. A few over-100k models retain real listing data gathered in an earlier research pass before this threshold rule was introduced; those are marked phase2_status = 'found_prior_to_threshold_rule' and the data is kept rather than discarded.
metadata.phase3_status: Not started / explicitly skipped for this run. Intended scope (see CLAUDE.md): real-budget definition, seller/dealer contact, viewing arrangement, negotiation, and final purchase decision.
metadata.specs_disclaimer: engine / fuel_or_charge_consumption / tank_or_battery_size fields are populated from established manufacturer specifications and general automotive knowledge, not individually re-verified via search for every model in this pass -- treat as good-faith approximations (flagged 'approx' where relevant), unlike the pricing/listing data which comes from live verified searches this session.
